description: The fight-arena capture's script for a fresh Aldric: the free starter kit first (the captured Aldric already held a quarterstaff: `You whap ...`), then the capture's steps unchanged. Newhaven Arena (1:2150): wait for a monster, `a <monster>` (*Combat Engaged*), the same attack re-sent while engaged, the fight to `*Combat Off*`, `get copper`, `rest` until healed (or interrupted), `exp`, back up the stairs, `buy healing` at the Newhaven healer (free at full HP), and log off.
behaviours: monster names in `Also here:` carry their alignment colour
recovery is rest and healers: `buy healing` (2 copper per missing HP) at full HP it costs nothing: `You hand over nothing and all your wounds are healed.`
the attack re-sent while engaged (what it does to the combat state)
the bell after `drops to the ground!` (if a player falls)

mask.why: every direction name carries a random capital letter and a backspace, rewritten each slow cycle: `nJ\borth`
the prompt's numbers only, never its labels (as m4)

mask.regex: (?<=for )\d+(?= damage)|(?<=You gain )\d+(?= experience)|\d+(?= (?:copper farthings?|silver nobles?|gold crowns?|platinum pieces?|runic coins?)\b)
mask.why: RNG: the damage, the experience share and the coin amounts, digits only (the words and the currency name stay compared)
the experience after random fights (st, exp): the number and its column padding, not the label
current hit points after random fights (st): the number and its padding, not the label or the maximum
experience still needed and its percentage (exp): digits only

notes: Monster chosen at run time: the last word of `Also here:` (script `set`).

steps.note: Newhaven, Weapons Shop: the starter kit costs nothing (WCCITEMS cost 0), the same on both servers
back to the Village Entrance, where the walk to the arena starts

into the arena; waits for the room's exits line, not the first prompt: a monster's line and its prompt can come before the room text (live run 38953732059, the original), and `Also here` must be in this step
waits for the room's exits line, not the first prompt: a monster's line and its prompt can come before the room text (live run 38953732059, the original), and `Also here` must be in this step
the same attack again while engaged

steps.until: \[HP={maxhp}\b|\*Combat Engaged\*|moves to attack you|at you|you for \d+|into the room
steps.note: until healed, attacked or a monster arrives (an attack ends resting)
